Risk and Data-Quality Rules

High Risk means the Beneish or Sloan hard threshold was exceeded. Medium Risk means the observation was close to a hard threshold or had an elevated z-score. Low Risk means no M-Score or Sloan threshold was exceeded. Data quality is Complete at 90% or more available SEC facts, Partial at 50% to 89.9%, and Insufficient below 50%.
